long_description:
We are delighted to announce that Bongotot 2026 Durga Puja will be held on October 17 and 18 at Newark Pavilion in Newark, California.

This will be the 5th Durga Pujo organized by Bongotot. We hope to make the event bigger and better without losing the sincerity, warmth, and bond of friendship that are hallmarks of any Bongotot event.

We sincerely hope we can make this event a grand success with everyone's active cooperation
